# Small Metal Panel
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Lay this down, then press \[F\] at it with a Screwdriver to build a permanent wall or with a Hammer to build a permanent floor.*

| Property | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Size | 11 |
| Category | Defence |
| Hit points | 5 |
| Carried in both hands | yes |
| Movable after placing | yes |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

## Crafting

No recipe makes or uses it.

## Scrap

Worth 4 [Scrap Metal](Scrap-Metal) in a Scrap Machine, see [Scrap](Scrap).
